summary: Frontend-only testing of the standalone ASTEO ticket app and React trigger button. Standalone HTML at /logiciel-ticket-asteo.html loads correctly, jsPDF CDN script is loaded (window.jspdf.jsPDF available), all 16 editable inputs present, and PDF export works. Downloaded PDFs verified as valid (%PDF header). Tested default filename '9848.pdf' and custom filename 'mon-ticket.pdf' after editing poidsNet=12500 and nCamion=AB-123-CD. Success message '✓ PDF enregistré : <name>.pdf' displayed in #msg after each export. React app's open-standalone-button exists, is visible/clickable, and opens the standalone HTML in a new tab. No page errors, no console errors.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Standalone HTML app fully functional; PDF export via jsPDF CDN works both with default and custom filenames after field edits. React root button opens the standalone HTML in a new tab correctly.
